user.title: Tesla Tracker
user.description: Pick the source entities from your Tesla Fleet integration and choose your tracking preferences.

data.idle_gap: Idle gap before a drive ends (seconds)
data.min_distance: Minimum distance to count as a drive (km)

data_description.odometer_entity: A numeric odometer sensor in kilometres. This is the primary source for distance.
data_description.tracker_entity: Used to record the route polyline and end-of-drive location.
data_description.shift_entity: If present, park/drive gear gives the most accurate drive boundaries.
data_description.idle_gap: How long the car must be stationary before a drive is considered finished.
data_description.min_distance: Drives shorter than this are discarded as noise.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity could not be found. Make sure the Tesla Fleet integration is set up first.

abort.already_configured: This odometer entity is already being tracked.

data.idle_gap: Idle gap before a drive ends (seconds)
data.min_distance: Minimum distance to count as a drive (km)

data_description.show_panel: Adds a local-first "Dashcam Viewer" item to the sidebar for reviewing TeslaCam / Sentry footage. Footage is read in your browser and never uploaded. The one-click folder picker needs HTTPS (e.g. Nabu Casa); drag-and-drop works on any connection.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity could not be found.

avg_distance_per_day_this_month.name: Average distance per driving day (this month)

recalculate.name: Recalculate
recalculate.description: Rebuild rollups from the stored drive history and refresh all sensors.

export_drives.name: Export drives
export_drives.description: Write the full drive history (with routes) to a JSON file in the configuration directory.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Target filename, relative to the configuration directory.

clear_history.name: Clear history
clear_history.description: Permanently delete all stored drives. Cannot be undone.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be enabled for the deletion to proceed.
